title: Detection and prebiotic chemistry of possible glycine precursor molecule methylenimine towards the hot molecular core G10.47+0.03
question: Can the possible glycine precursor methylenimine (CH2NH) be detected towards the hot core G10.47+0.03 with ACA, and what are its column density, temperature and abundance, and likely formation route?

what.value: H2 column density of 1.30e23 cm^-2 used for abundance

evidence.quote: the column density of H$_{2}$ towards G10.47+0.03 was 1.30$\times$10$^{23}$ cm$^{-2}$ (cite: suz16)

evidence.loc: 3.2 Identification of the CH$_{2}$NH in the G10.47+0.03
evidence.quote: The systematic velocity ($V_{LSR}$) of G10.47+0.03 is 68.50 km s$^{-1}$ (cite: rof11).

what.value: Partition functions of CH2NH from CDMS

evidence.quote: The rotational partition function of CH$_{2}$NH at 75 K is 740.457, that at 150 K is 2084.970, and that at 300 K is 5892.504 (cite: mu05).

recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, mstransform, uvcontsub, tclean cubes, impbcor

recipe.goal: Identify CH2NH lines via LTE modelling
recipe.method: Extract spectrum in 23.75″ circle, subtract 2nd-order polynomial baseline, fit LTE model with CDMS in CASSIS using MCMC
assumptions: LTE valid given gas density 7e7 cm^-3

recipe.method: Gaussian fits (Levenberg-Marquardt) to lines, optically thin rotational diagram in CASSIS
assumptions: Optically thin, LTE; N(H2)=1.30e23 cm^-2 for abundance

recipe.method: immoments over line velocity ranges, imfit 2D Gaussian, deconvolve via theta_S

evidence.quote: (3.40$\pm$0.2)$\times$10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ with a rotational temperature of 218.70$\pm$20 K
The fractional abundance of CH$_{2}$NH with respect to H$_{2}$ towards G10.47+0.03 is 2.61$\times$10$^{-8}$.

evidence.loc: 3.2 Identification of the CH$_{2}$NH in the G10.47+0.03
evidence.quote: the best-fit column density of CH$_{2}$NH was (3.21$\pm$1.5)$\times$10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ with an excitation temperature of 210.50$\pm$32.82 K
The emitting region of CH$_{2}$NH varied between 10.520$^{\prime\prime}$ and 10.781$^{\prime\prime}$.

not_stated_but_needed: Image size, cell size, cleaning threshold, niter, masks
Spectral window / channel width after imaging and velocity frame
CASSIS MCMC priors and fit ranges
Source size and partition function used for the CH2NH rotational-diagram fit
Details of the glycine upper limits (line frequencies, assumed Tex, linewidth)
score_reason: Public data and software named, but imaging and fit details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public ACA data, simple rotational-diagram recipe, numeric results.
